subject: general
question: The H.C.F. and the L.C.M. of two numbers are 11 and 440, respectively. If one of the numbers is 55, find the other one.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Product of **H.C.F.** and **L.C.M.** = Product of the **two numbers**.

11 × 440 = 55 × Other Number

Other Number = (11 × 440) ÷ 55 = 440 ÷ 5 = 88

**∴ The correct answer is 88.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**H.C.F.** = 11

**L.C.M.** = 440

**First Number (a)** = 55

**Formula Used:**

H.C.F. × L.C.M. = a × b

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0b4f49a15d035246eb7cb38f9dcad12aeb4e7f71ffb447b5f3b6c32662738e9.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the other number be **b**.

⇒ 11 × 440 = 55 × b

⇒ 4840 = 55b

⇒ b = 4840 ÷ 55

⇒ b = 88

**∴ The correct answer is 88.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

H.C.F. Property

The **Highest Common Factor** (H.C.F.) of two or more numbers is the largest number that divides each of them exactly. H.C.F. is always a factor of the L.C.M.

L.C.M. Property

The **Least Common Multiple** (L.C.M.) is the smallest non-zero common multiple of two or more numbers.

Co-prime Numbers

For two **co-prime numbers**, their H.C.F. is always 1 and their L.C.M. is equal to the product of the numbers.</p
